handling: reserved outcome data: acquired, hashed and reconciled across sources; not joined to any forecast and not scored in this task
limits: The retained tennis-data 2026 workbooks are Wayback captures of 2026-08-03; they contain no row after 2026-08-03 and therefore cover neither Winston-Salem, the Canadian Open, Cincinnati, Monterrey nor the US Open.

The two 2026-08-03 Mubadala DC Open final rows in those workbooks carry a named winner with no set scores and no comment; their orientation disagrees with the played result, so they are as-of-capture provisional records, not outcomes.

Wikipedia draw pages carry no per-match date or start time. Only the tournament week label is available from the season calendar; tennis-data supplies a date field whose semantics remain the unresolved question recorded for MQ01.
Wikipedia is a labelled secondary source written after the fact. Every row is marked source=wikipedia and carries the parser version, page URL and retrieval time.
The Odds API /scores payload reports sets won, not per-set games, and only three days back; it cannot corroborate rounds before 2026-09-08.

No Polymarket market in the TICK01 live capture is resolved. The collector's discovery query filters closed=false and has only run since 2026-09-11T00:52Z, so a resolution cannot appear in it. Terminal prices are not resolutions.
Reconciliation lists disagreements and does not choose a winner for any match.
